GFM TERMINAL — PREVIEW AND DATA DIAGNOSIS / PATCH 0.5.1

The user reported that the Codex file preview displayed controls without
producing results. This environment's browser automation rejects local-file
URLs, so no live rendered browser check or preview-policy diagnosis is claimed.

The actual delivered 0.5 HTML was parsed into its real IDs and script blocks
and executed in an isolated browser-like JavaScript context. That check found
no packaged startup failure. The actual button/form commands produced raw
datasets, transforms, inverse recovery, exports and a ledger record. Those
checks do not establish that a particular app preview executes scripts.

Official OpenAI documentation says HTML files can have interactive previews
when that feature is available. It does not establish the script behavior of
the user's current preview. An absent script runtime is consistent with the
reported visible controls and absent data, but is not proven by that report.
Source: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/artifacts-viewer?surface=app

WHAT PATCH 0.5.1 CHANGES

The terminal now shows an engine readiness message above its live controls.
Controls start disabled and become active only after all modules, renderers
and event bindings complete. Startup errors display their message. If scripts
do not execute at all, the waiting message and disabled controls remain visible.

The expanded completed-example section is generated from an actual GFM
calculation before the HTML is saved. It shows the equation, nine input values,
GF9 trace coefficients, inverse-recovered values and measured error. It remains
readable without JavaScript. It is labelled as saved data, not a live run.

docs/Pendulum_Example.html is a separate document with no scripts or live
controls. It shows the same completed calculation. Its CSV and JSON companions
retain full numeric values. No browser session, local server or external
deployment is required to read those files. New live calculations require the
terminal's script runtime.

TO RUN LIVE CALCULATIONS

Extract the complete terminal package. In Windows File Explorer, open its
folder and double-click Open-Terminal.cmd. This opens index.html in your
regular browser. This manual opening route is provided for the user; the agent
has not launched a different browser to bypass the rejected automation action.

Check that the top message says the live GFM calculation engine is ready.
Run sequence applies the default pendulum equation to raw GF9 samples.
Enter gfm.verify to leave the recovery checks in Return Explorer. Details and
JSON show the active result. Reapply equations evaluates the registered raw
image and exterior-signal adapters with their original domains and scale.

If the engine message stays pending, scripts have not completed startup there.
If it shows an error, the exact displayed message identifies a startup failure.
Report that message and the opening route to diagnose it further. Avoid judging
data production from an unchanged last record receipt: the active dataset and
its table contain the sample/coefficient values; the receipt describes storage.

COMPATIBILITY

This patch leaves the mathematical engines, source files, earlier saved
examples, audit reports and dataset/session contracts unchanged. Product
version is 0.5.1; the established 0.5.0 session envelope version is retained
because its data format is unchanged. Original output releases are preserved.

VERIFICATION

The saved example was independently reconstructed in standard-library Python.
The actual assembled page is tested in an isolated JavaScript/DOM context.
These are calculation, startup and interaction checks, not rendered browser
or actual download/iframe verification. See validation/ for the completed
numeric checks and test output.
